question: Within 50 kilometers, where can I find a museum ahead of Charlotte's Quest Nature Center, Manchester, MD toward United States Naval Academy, Annapolis, MD?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Charlotte\'s Quest Nature Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Manchester%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MD%' LIMIT 1) AS start_point, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%United States Naval Academy%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Annapolis%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MD%' LIMIT 1) AS end_point WHERE p.tourism = 'museum' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, start_point.geometry::geography, 50000) AND p.id != (SELECT id FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Charlotte\'s Quest Nature Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Manchester%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MD%' LIMIT 1) -- Exclude the start point itself AND ( -- Calculate the angular difference between the direction from start_point to end_point, -- and the direction from start_point to the current museum (p). -- Ensure the museum is generally "ahead" in the desired direction within a 90-degree cone (45 degrees on either side). LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(start_point.geometry, p.geometry)) - degrees(ST_Azimuth(start_point.geometry, end_point.geometry))), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(start_point.geometry, p.geometry)) - degrees(ST_Azimuth(start_point.geometry, end_point.geometry))) ) <= 45 ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, start_point.geometry::geography);
